title: Fluency and idiom
summary: Stacked modality and degrees of certainty, dense written Turkish, the Ottoman layer of the vocabulary, idioms and proverbs, word order for emphasis, and the spoken language.
canDo: Express degrees of certainty about past and present events
Read academic and literary prose built on long nominalized clauses
Recognize Ottoman, Arabic and Persian structures, and use common idioms and proverbs
Follow fast informal speech and argue a point in writing
